thread:
alex: Quick heads-up — planning a staggered engine swap tonight during the 23:00-03:00 UTC window. This includes a kernel ABI tweak (hash abc1234) + quant matmul v2 build (artifact QZ-12). Need final signoffs on canary metrics, rollout slices, and rollback thresholds.

anya: ETA on canaries? which regions first?

alex: Canary US-east then EU-west. Plan: 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% with 15m observation at each step. Start at 23:05 UTC to avoid billing batch at 23:30.

kevin: Ops note — holdback policy for Dedicated customers: pin engine 3.3 for 1h post-100% for any customer flagged on the old contract. I'll prepare the pin command.

maria: Changelog blurb: "engine: kernel ABI change (abc1234); improved quantized matmul performance (QZ-12)." I'll drop a short release note in #announcements if we hit 100%.

sanju: Observability checklist: dashboards for p50/p95/p99, error-rate, model-ops-retry, kv-cache-hit. I'll attach the dashboard links to the deploy ticket. Quick query to watch: 
```
sum(rate(request_errors[5m])) / sum(rate(requests[5m])) * 100 as error_pct
```
Trigger for rollback: error_pct > 0.8 for two consecutive 5m windows OR p99 latency > 2s and sustained qps drop > 20%.

deploy-bot: Preflight: build QZ-12 verified on staging, kernel abc1234 passes compat tests, canary images baked. Deploy command lined up: 
```
/deploy engine:3.4-kernel:abc1234 quant:QZ-12 --staged "canary-us=5,canary-eu=5" --notify #eng-runtime --dry-run
```

anya: Suggest adding a safety TTL pin for 4h after full rollout in case of slow regressions. Ops rollback runbook should be ready.

kevin: Agreed. I'll set a sticky-pin: 
```
/deploybot pin engine:3.3 --scope dedicated --ttl 4h --reason "safety holdback"
```

maria: One more: release notes should mention fallback behavior: traffic routed to engine:3.3 if kernel-compat fails. Adds reassurance for customers.

sanju: I'll create an alert runbook entry and include the rollback play: 
- Step 1: Halt rollout -> cut traffic to 3.3 variant for affected region
- Step 2: Trigger full rollback using /deploy rollback --to engine:3.3 --regions <region-list>
- Step 3: Invalidate KV cache entries if p99 latency spike tied to cache-miss pattern

alex: Can someone volunteer to own the 25% -> 50% handoff and be on-call for the window?

kevin: I'll own the US handoff. cc @maria for release comms.

anya: I'll own EU and the rollback execution path.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: canary-us=5% (deploy id dpl-789), timestamp 1759999800. Preflight hooks passed.

ops-bot: Reminder: change window notice sent to SRE oncall 30m prior.

maria: If we hit the p99 trigger at any stage I want a short post-mortem template ready. Adding PT team to the thread.

alex: Ok green on signoffs from owners: kevin (US), anya (EU), sanju (observability), maria (comm). Proceed at 23:05 UTC. I'll post the short release note once we hit 100%.

kevin: Rolling to 25% now. Will post updates every 15m.

anya: 25% EU started. No immediate regressions.

deploy-bot: Roll to 25% complete: canary-us=25% (dpl-790), canary-eu=25% (dpl-791). Monitoring windows open.

sanju: First 15m looks clean. error_pct=0.09%, p99=620ms, kv-cache-hit stable.

maria: Draft release note queued.

kevin: Moving to 50% in 10m.

anya: 50% EU complete, no change.

deploy-bot: Roll to 50% complete (dpl-792).

sanju: Uh — slight p99 drift in US: p99=1.9s in last 5m, but error_pct still 0.2%. Watching for trend.

kevin: If p99 crosses 2s next window we'll roll back that region only. Standby to execute.

deploy-bot: Roll to 100% scheduled in 10m pending no-trigger.

alex: decision: if any region meets rollback trigger we will abort global and roll that region back to engine:3.3, hold full rollout.

anya: Confirming EU stays at 100% freeze if US rolls back.

kevin: US hit p99 2.3s now and error_pct 0.95% over last 5m. Initiating regional rollback to 3.3.

deploy-bot: Executing rollback in us-east: /deploy rollback --to engine:3.3 --regions us-east (dpl-793).

sanju: After rollback: p99 dropped to 610ms and error_pct 0.08% within 3m. Will keep monitoring.

maria: Posting tailored note to customers in affected regions.

alex: Good runbook execution — we'll pause the global rollout, open a postmortem with initial notes, and schedule a follow-up to iterate on quant build under load. Thanks all.

maria: Opening postmortem draft and will ping attendees for timeline.

kevin: Leaving sticky pin active for 4h.

anya: Adding action item: reproduce p99 regression on perf-rack with QZ-12 + abc1234 to root cause.

sanju: I'll run additional KV/cache stress tests tomorrow morning post-window.

alex: Thread closed for tonight. We'll reconvene after preliminary RCA. :thumbsup:
